name: 2018 CB
notes: Observed one day before its close approach to Earth (0.000466 au, 2018-02-09). Class from the spectral distance to the DeMeo et al. (2009) class means and to SMASSII spectra; conservatively, X-type. Super-fast rotator (P = 0.089241 h; Birtwhistle 2021).
